# 1 in 7 - Endometriosis & Adenomyosis Resources

> Evidence-based resource hub for Endometriosis and Adenomyosis patients, caregivers, and advocates. Named for the statistic that 1 in 7 women and people assigned female at birth are affected. The site is privacy-first with zero third-party requests, no trackers, and all user data stored on-device only. Available in 26 languages.

Endometriosis affects approximately 190 million people worldwide. Average diagnosis time is 7-10 years from symptom onset. The gold standard treatment is laparoscopic excision surgery. There is currently no cure for either condition. Hysterectomy treats Adenomyosis but does NOT treat Endometriosis because lesions exist outside the uterus. Endometriosis can affect any organ system, not just reproductive organs.

## Condition guides

- [Endometriosis](https://1in7.info/endometriosis/): Comprehensive guide to Endometriosis covering symptoms by stage (I-IV), causes, risk factors, diagnostic methods, and a medical term glossary
- [Adenomyosis](https://1in7.info/adenomyosis/): Guide to Adenomyosis covering symptoms, types (focal vs diffuse), diagnosis via imaging, treatment options including uterine-sparing procedures, and its relationship to Endometriosis
- [Co-morbidities](https://1in7.info/comorbidities/): Research-backed comorbidity data including gynecological, gastrointestinal, neurological, mental health, autoimmune, and novel associations with Endometriosis and Adenomyosis

## Getting started

- [Symptom Quiz](https://1in7.info/quiz/): Interactive checklist of 9 common Endometriosis and Adenomyosis symptoms with personalized next steps based on how many apply to you
- [Just Diagnosed: Your First 90 Days](https://1in7.info/just-diagnosed/): Step-by-step roadmap for newly diagnosed patients covering medical records, understanding your diagnosis, finding a specialist, symptom tracking, mental health, and financial planning
- [Myths & Facts](https://1in7.info/myths/): Debunking common Endometriosis and Adenomyosis myths with evidence-based facts and medical sources
- [FAQ](https://1in7.info/faq/): 20+ frequently asked questions and answers about Endometriosis and Adenomyosis covering conditions, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, fertility, and daily life

## Diagnosis and specialists

- [Diagnosis](https://1in7.info/diagnosis/): Diagnostic methods (ultrasound, MRI, laparoscopy), symptom staging, emerging diagnostics (biomarker tests, AI-assisted imaging), and what to expect from each approach
- [Find a Specialist](https://1in7.info/find-a-specialist/): Vetted specialist directories (iCareBetter, Yellow Hub, Roon, Hale), what to look for in a specialist, types of specialists (MIGS surgeons, pelvic pain specialists), questions to ask, diagnostic tools, and AI-enabled research platforms

## Treatment and management

- [Treatments](https://1in7.info/treatments/): Overview of surgical options (excision, ablation, robot-assisted), hormonal medications (combined OCP, progestins, GnRH agonists/antagonists), non-hormonal options (NSAIDs, tranexamic acid), and complementary approaches (pelvic physiotherapy, diet, acupuncture)
- [Surgery Costs](https://1in7.info/surgery-costs/): Real patient-reported surgery cost data from multiple countries showing quoted fees, insurance-billed amounts, and out-of-pocket costs for Endometriosis and Adenomyosis procedures
- [Medications](https://1in7.info/medications/): Detailed comparison of hormonal and non-hormonal medications used to treat Endometriosis and Adenomyosis including dosages, side effects, and effectiveness
- [Fertility](https://1in7.info/fertility/): How Endometriosis and Adenomyosis affect fertility, IVF success rates, egg freezing, natural conception guidance, and fertility preservation options
- [Symptom Tracker](https://1in7.info/tracker/): Private on-device symptom tracking tool with CSV export and print support - data never leaves the browser, no account required

## Mental health and support

- [Mental Health](https://1in7.info/mental-health/): Psychological impact of chronic pelvic pain, therapy options (CBT, ACT, EMDR, MBSR), crisis support resources, and coping strategies
- [Partners and Family](https://1in7.info/partners-and-family/): Guide for partners, family members, and caregivers on understanding Endometriosis and Adenomyosis, what to say, how to help during flares, and self-care for supporters
- [Take Action](https://1in7.info/take-action/): Copyable scripts and templates for talking to doctors, employers, family, and partners about Endometriosis or Adenomyosis

## Learn and advocate

- [Notable People](https://1in7.info/notable-people/): 60+ public figures who have spoken openly about their Endometriosis diagnosis, surgeries, and advocacy work
- [In Memory](https://1in7.info/in-memory/): Honoring those lost to complications of Endometriosis
- [Research](https://1in7.info/research/): Scientific research organizations, current studies, clinical trials, genetic research, and emerging treatment pipelines
- [Education](https://1in7.info/education/): Films, books, podcasts, and community resources for Endometriosis and Adenomyosis awareness and understanding

## Optional

- [About](https://1in7.info/about/): About the project - a community-driven open-source initiative
- [Privacy](https://1in7.info/privacy/): Privacy policy - by default, no data leaves your device

## Site information

- URL: https://1in7.info
- Languages: 26 (English default, includes Arabic with RTL support, Italian fully translated)
- Privacy: Zero third-party requests, no tracking, no analytics, self-hosted fonts (Figtree, OFL 1.1)
- Accessibility: WCAG AA compliant, keyboard navigable, screen reader optimized, prefers-reduced-motion respected
